project.name: High Ercall Townscape Guide
project.boundarySource: ONS Built-up Areas (December 2024) with curated adjoining public green spaces
project.researchNotes: Townscape Guides batch audit completed 2026-08-12. Historic England and current public OpenStreetMap records were filtered point-in-polygon. The original settlement boundary is preserved in townStudyArea; 1 directly adjoining public green-space geometries were included in the active visitor boundary. Historic England official list-entry date enrichment reviewed 2026-08-12: 9 of 11 statutory records now carry defensible date evidence; uncaptured or unresolved entries are retained as unknown and listed in the county audit.

touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: High Ercall qualifies as a local detour through Church of St Michael and remains of churchyard cross and Standing cross in the churchyard of St Michael and All Angels' Church, High Ercall. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: High Ercall: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
townGuide.intro: High Ercall offers Church of St Michael and remains of churchyard cross, Standing cross in the churchyard of St Michael and All Angels' Church, High Ercall within a compact settlement visit, supported by curated daytime food and practical facilities where mapped.
